job.question: What is the proposal submission deadline in the Oklahoma Public Employees Retirement System (OPERS) investment consulting services RFP?
job.acceptance: Accept Central Time/CT; explicit equivalent timezone conversion acceptable.

reviews.reason: The document is a 2016 South Carolina Retirement System Investment Commission RFP, not the Oklahoma Public Employees Retirement System RFP. Its proposal deadline does not support the requested deadline.
quotes: South Carolina Retirement System Investment Commission General Investment Consulting Services RFP
Deadline for Proposal Submission December 1, 2016 – 5:00 p.m. EST
